narration: {enemy} follows through with {enemy_weapon}, leaving you no time to mistake distance for safety.
{enemy} closes the narrow space and delivers its ordinary killing motion.
The warning becomes movement: {enemy} drives {enemy_weapon} through your chosen line.
{enemy} commits its whole weight behind {enemy_weapon}; the impact makes the ground seem closer.
The promised heavy blow arrives. {enemy} has sacrificed balance for a single overwhelming impact.
{enemy} releases the force it gathered, carrying {enemy_weapon} through a brutally wide arc.
{enemy} sweeps {enemy_weapon} across the ground you hoped to use for escape.
The broad attack takes away the sideways route. {enemy} catches the edge of your movement.
{enemy} crosses your path with a low, searching sweep instead of a direct blow.
Behind its compact defense, {enemy} answers with a shorter motion of {enemy_weapon}.
{enemy} stays covered and sends a restrained counter through the small opening you leave.
The enemy does not abandon its protection. A quick response follows from inside its guarded posture.
{enemy} gathers force instead of striking. Its next committed motion will be a heavy blow.
A tightening movement runs through {enemy}; the gathering force has not reached you yet.
{enemy} commits to preparation. For this moment there is no blow, only the promise of the next one.
{enemy} regains its balance without attacking. The exposed interval is already passing.
The last movement has left {enemy} extended; it spends this exchange putting itself back into position.
{enemy} settles into reach again. Nothing strikes at you while it recovers its fighting posture.

execution.description: Execution: +30% damage against an enemy at or below 40% HP; mastery +45%.
hit: You drive {weapon} through the opening before it closes.
Your {weapon} catches the enemy as it shifts its weight.
You commit to the strike, bringing {weapon} home with both feet planted.

counter.description: Counter: Riposte adds 50% damage instead of 25%; mastery 65%.
hit: You turn the enemy's movement against it with {weapon}.
Your {weapon} answers the space left by the enemy's attack.
You plant your heel and send {weapon} back along the line of attack.

precision.description: Precision: attacking with Opening adds 30% damage; mastery 40%.
hit: You steady {weapon} and place the shot through a narrow gap.
The sight of {weapon} settles for a breath. You fire.
You squeeze the trigger of {weapon} as the enemy crosses your sights.

disruption.description: Disruption: a hit of 15+ interrupts Heavy. Mastery needs 13+. Then unavailable for two exchanges.
hit: You press {weapon} into reach; its charge snaps across the contact.
A dry electrical crack follows the strike of your {weapon}.
You close the distance with {weapon}, letting its current carry the blow.

suppression.description: Suppression: a hit of 15+ reduces an organic enemy's response by 30%; mastery 40%. Machines resist suppression.
hit: You bring {weapon} level and fire into the enemy's advance.
The report of {weapon} cuts across the distance between you.
You stand your ground, sending a shot from {weapon} into the approaching threat.
You strike with your bare hands and pull back before the reply.
You put your weight behind a short, desperate blow.
You find a gap close enough to reach without a weapon.

miss: Your attack finds the space the enemy has just left.
You commit too early. The blow passes without purchase.
The angle closes before your attack arrives.
critical_failure: Your footing slips at the moment of commitment, leaving you exposed.
You overreach. Recovering your balance costs the space you needed.
The attack carries you past your cover and into the enemy's reach.
critical_success: Everything aligns for a single, decisive instant.
You find the cleanest line through the struggle.
The opening is brief, but you meet it without hesitation.
kill_organic: The last resistance gives way. The threat can no longer follow you.
The enemy falls out of the fight, leaving only your breathing.
Your final strike ends the struggle before another reply can come.
kill_machine: The mechanism locks. Its weapon falls silent.
The last drive gives out, leaving metal motionless on the road.
Its lights go dark one after another. Nothing inside answers again.
block_success: You catch the force against your guard and turn it aside. A reply is within reach.
The impact holds against your defense. You shove back into the space it leaves.
You meet the blow squarely and send it away from your body.
block_failure: The blow slips past your guard while your weight is committed.
Your defense folds at the wrong angle, opening a path to your body.
You brace too late. The impact drives through your exposed stance.
dodge_success: You step beyond the attack and find a clean line back.
The strike passes close enough to feel. You are already beside it.
You move with the enemy's commitment, leaving its attack behind.
dodge_failure: You try to clear the attack, but your feet cannot find the space.
The enemy reaches the place you meant to escape into.
Your sidestep comes a breath too late.
idle_defense: You hold your defense while the enemy gathers itself. No blow comes.
You keep clear, but the enemy spends the moment preparing.
You wait behind your guard. The expected impact never arrives.
interrupt: The charge breaks the attack before it can land.
The heavy strike stops halfway through its commitment.
The enemy's gathering force collapses under the interruption.
suppressed: The enemy flinches and its reply loses force.
Your shot breaks its nerve just long enough to blunt the response.
It pulls away from the report, weakening the attack already begun.
opportunity: You seize the opening with {weapon}, committing everything to this strike.
For one breath the fight belongs to you. You bring {weapon} to bear.
You see the moment you have been waiting for and drive {weapon} into it.
flee: You break contact and leave the threat behind without stopping to search.
An opening leads away from the fight. You take it and keep moving.
You gain enough distance to escape, abandoning any claim to the spoils.
flee_failure: The route closes before you can break contact.
You turn toward an exit that the enemy reaches first.
Your retreat runs out of space. The enemy is still upon you.
smoke: Smoke fills the space between you. You leave before it thins.
You pull the fuse and disappear behind the sudden wall of smoke.
The cloud swallows the fight. You follow its cover out of reach.
enemy_hit: {enemy} answers with {enemy_weapon}, driving the attack toward you.
The force of {enemy_weapon} reaches you before you can reset your stance.
{enemy} follows through, bringing {enemy_weapon} into the exchange.
enemy_critical: The attack finds a particularly vulnerable opening.
The full force of the attack arrives before you can recover.
The enemy catches you at the worst point of the exchange.
enemy_fumble: The enemy's attack falters before it reaches full force.
The reply comes awkwardly, with much of its force spent.
Its movement catches and the strike loses momentum.
charge: The threat gathers force. The next exchange will be dangerous.
Nothing strikes yet; the enemy is preparing something heavier.
You have one breath while the attack takes shape.
recover: The enemy needs a moment to recover. Its defense is open.
The last movement leaves it unbalanced and within reach.
It draws back to recover, leaving you time to act.
defended: Your defense takes the committed attack away from your body. No injury follows it through.
You read the motion in time; nothing reaches flesh beneath your equipment.
The enemy completes its motion, but you have already denied it an effective target.
